nodes.label: Visibility (Down/Up)
nodes.rationale: Visibility lives on a thin per-card wrapper (HoleCard), not on Card itself: visibility is a property of being held by a seat in a poker game, not of the card. Adding it to Card would bloat every deck/board/evaluator call site. Mental poker (EPIC-79) notes it really wants three states: masked, known-to-owner, public.
